text: {"lessons":["Selling winners feels rewarding, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider each trade’s role in my overall portfolio.","Buying back stocks after selling them can mean paying a higher price, so I should make those decisions based on a clear plan rather than regret or recent price moves.","These few periods do not show that past price changes predict future returns; I should stay diversified and assess risk instead of extrapolating short-term results."]}
